data.body: **[P2] Test the layer-only runtime contract before publishing.** The archive contains only the thin plugin JAR, but existing OTel conformance packages the plugin and OTel SDK into the function and registers the plugin in code. It therefore cannot catch ServiceLoader, classloader, or missing-dependency failures encountered by layer consumers. Add a PR-running integration test using this ZIP with dynamic plugin discovery and without the plugin dependencies in the function artifact.
